title: hYYa Footprint Inspector
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo, hlola izimvume uzilungise. Kumahhala, kuyimfihlo.
fullDescription:
Izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza zingazi okuningi ngawe ukudlula lokho okucabangayo. I-hYYa Footprint Inspector ikukhombisa lokho ezikubonayo, ezinokufinyelela okukhethekile, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani ngamagama alula.

IZINYATHELO EZINE EZILULA
1. Umkhondo wedivayisi: ngokuthepha kanye kuhlola umkhondo wedijithali nanoma yini uhlelo olungayifunda ngedivayisi yakho (device fingerprint).
2. Izinhlelo ezibucayi: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zakho abanye abangazibona, njengezinhlelo zokujola, ezokukholwa, ezempilo noma ama-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungadalulani ngawe.
3. Amathuluzi okulandelela: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezingafunda isikrini sakho, zifunde zonke izaziso, noma zikhiye idivayisi yakho. Izinhlelo ezinamalungelo angaphezu kwelilodwa kulawa zinezimpawu, ngoba yileyo ndlela amathuluzi okulandelela nezinhlelo zokuqapha ezisebenza ngayo. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android elikhombisa ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezisebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera kanye nombhobho.
4. Ukuhlola ubumfihlo: landela izinyathelo ezilula njengezibuyekezo, ukuqalisa kabusha idivayisi masonto onke kanye nokuhlola amaphasiwedi adaluliwe, bese ubuyekeza Izilungiselelo zakho kancane kancane futhi ubuyise izimvume zama-app ongafuni ukuzinikeza.

AMAPHUZU AMANYE KUWO WOMANE
Amaphuzu akho obumfihlo, ebalwa ku-100, ahlanganisa konke ukuhlola ubumfihlo okune ndawonye. Uma ephakeme angcono kakhulu, futhi ayakhula njengoba uqeda ukuhlola ngakunye. Engeza i-widget ukuze ubone amaphuzu akho nokuhlola kwakho kokugcina ngokubheka nje kanye.

LUNGISA NAMI
Thepha u-"Lungisa nami" bese uhlelo lukuhola kulungiso ngalunye, lunye ngalunye, likusiza ukuthi uthole Izilungiselelo ezifanele ngokushesha. Bese uhlola futhi ubuke amaphuzu akho enyuka.

KUCACILE, KUNOKUTHULA KANYE NOKWETHEMBEKA
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: okubomvu kudinga ukubhekisiswa, okuphuzi kuhle ukukwazi, okuluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholakele kuchazwe ngamagama acacile: isihloko esifushane, umugqa owodwa ochaza ukuthi kungani kubalulekile, nendlela yokukulungisa.
• Izinhlelo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kudivayisi yakho aziphawulwa, kanti izinhlelo zokulawula kwabazali noma ezomsebenzi zibizwa ngokwalokho eziyikho ngempela.
• Incazelo ethembekile yokuthi "ngu-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongakulungisa lokhu" uma kungekho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samasonto onke noma senyanga sokuhlola futhi, uma usithanda.

UKUBONAKALA NOMA USUSUSE UHLELO
I-Android inikeza izinhlelo zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala injalo noma ngabe uyazisusa uphinde uzifake kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasembonini kuphela okuyishintshayo.

OKWAKHIWE KUCATSHANGELWA UBUMFIHLO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: uhlelo alukwazi ukuxhuma noma kuphi, ngakho-ke akukho lutho olushiya idivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
• Kumahhala. Akukho ukuthenga, akukho ukubhalisa.
• I-open source, ukuze noma ngubani akwazi ukuhlola ukuthi isebenza kanjani.

Hlangana nomseshi: usekhasini ngalinye futhi unethiphu uma umthepha.

I-hYYa Footprint Inspector iyingxenye yomndeni we-hYYa wezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibeka ubumfihlo kuqala.
releaseNotes:
• Izinyathelo ezintsha zokuhlola ubumfihlo zikusiza uvikele idivayisi yakho, ama-akhawunti nezinhlelo zokuxhumana.
Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ukulungiswa kweziphazamisi ezijwayelekile kanye nokuthuthukiswa kokuzinza.
